script: Julie: Hi everyone, I'm going to tell you all about my wonderful trip to Venice last week. I went with my family. We arrived on Saturday morning at about 10:00 a.m. It's very easy to get from the airport to Venice as you can either go by train or bus from the airport, or you can do it the more romantic way which is by boat. The boats are called Vaporetti and they are very long and narrow so that they can sail down the canals easily. The wonderful thing about going by boat is that you can see a lot of the city before you've even checked into your hotel. We stayed in an area of Venice called Arsenal. We were on the boat for over an hour before we got to our stop. We set off at 10:15 and we arrived there at 11:30. On the way, we cruised past most of the outside of the city. The cheapest way of traveling around Venice is of course on foot, but after a while you will probably get very tired. You can buy a three-day ticket to use on the Vaporetto which only costs 20 pounds. We also bought a museum card for 30 pounds which we could use to go into the museums, art galleries and churches. That saved us a lot of money. Apart from its fantastic buildings and squares, Venice is most famous for its canals. The thing I enjoyed most was walking over the many beautiful bridges and watching the boats beneath us. Now I'd like to mention the food in Venice. There are plenty of restaurants all over the city. As you would expect, there are plenty of pizza and pasta restaurants, but the nicest thing to eat in Venice is fish. On the last day we sat and drank fresh juice on the Grand Canal. I took many photos for my friends and bought lots of Italian sweets. My parents bought some toy boats for our cousins. It was the perfect city holiday.

items.quote: you can either go by train or bus from the airport, or you can do it the more romantic way which is by boat.
items.uz: Aeroportdan Venetsiyaga borishning uchta usuli aytilgan: poyezd (train), avtobus (bus) yoki qayiq (boat). Ro'yxatda poyezd tushirib qoldirilgan.

items.quote: We set off at 10:15 and we arrived there at 11:30.
items.uz: "Set off" iborasi "yo'lga chiqish" degan ma'noni anglatadi. Julie qayiqda soat 10:15 da yo'lga chiqqanini aytadi. 11:30 esa yetib borish vaqti.

items.quote: We also bought a museum card for 30 pounds
items.uz: Julie muzey kartasi 30 funt turishini aytadi. 20 funt esa transport uchun uch kunlik chipta narxi edi, adashtirib yubormang.

items.quote: The thing I enjoyed most was walking over the many beautiful bridges
items.uz: Juliega eng yoqqan narsa chiroyli ko'priklar (bridges) ustidan yurish bo'lgan. U binolar va maydonlarni ham maqtagan, lekin ko'priklarni alohida ta'kidlagan.

items.quote: the nicest thing to eat in Venice is fish.
items.uz: Julie Venetsiyada yeyish mumkin bo'lgan eng mazali narsa baliq (fish) ekanligini aytadi. Pizza va pasta ham bor, lekin baliq eng yaxshisi deb ta'riflangan.

items.quote: My parents bought some toy boats for our cousins.
items.uz: Julie o'zi uchun shirinliklar (sweets), qarindoshlari uchun esa o'yinchoq qayiqlar (toy boats) sotib olinganini aytadi.
